provenance.product: 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM (seamless, bare earth), Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF
provenance.hashScope: SHA-256 of the native Float32 pixels of each tile window read
provenance.license: Public domain (U.S. Government work); credit U.S. Geological Survey

fill.verticalReference: unverified (mixed-source Terrain Tiles; nominally metres above mean sea level)
fill.rule: fill only where the primary source has no data; linear blend over featherCells inside primary coverage

provenance.product: Terrarium PNG tiles, zoom 12 (mixed SRTM/3DEP/GMTED/ETOPO sources)
provenance.hashScope: SHA-256 of each PNG tile as downloaded

source.verticalReference: NAVD88 orthometric height, metres (USGS 3DEP product specification)

axes: X east, Y up, Z south (metres)

lod.framings: core tiles meet the pixel budget at their closest unoccluded approach; extended-only tiles at budgetScale x; hidden tiles are not drawn
lod.triangulation: quads split along the (0,0)-(1,1) diagonal; finer edges snap to the coarser neighbour

hydrology.flow: log2(D8 accumulation over depression-filled heights) * 16, capped 254
